title: 第7章 王艳之痛第8章 说谁潘金莲
content_zh:
天亮了，王艳被一阵激烈的敲门声惊醒。
她这才想起张有权被锁在厢房里。
王艳挣扎着想爬起来，但是浑身酸软，像散架一样，动一下哪哪都疼。
“哎呦！”王艳无奈地躺下，转过头看着旁边的叶开。
叶开还在熟睡中，那长长的睫毛，高挺的鼻梁，方正的唇，让王艳爱不释手，越看越喜欢。
多帅的小伙啊！
体力太好了，牛犊都比不上他。
活了二十多年，总算做了回真正的女人，就算死了也值了！
想想昨晚，真过瘾！
要是能嫁给他就好了，王艳在心里感叹。
看着叶开，王艳忽然又来了精神，她决定不管张有权了，
让那个老家伙在厢房叫吧，谁叫他没有用的！
想到这里，王艳紧紧地抱着叶开。
“咚咚咚！”外面的敲门声又响起。
叶开清醒过来，“不好，张有权还在厢房呢！”
王艳若无其事地说：“别管他，叫他喊吧，等他喊累了就老实了！”
“不行啊，他老是喊，会把邻居喊来的。”
“也是哈，我去把他放出来。”
“别着急，等我走了你再放他出来。”
王艳惊讶地看着叶开，这话还像一个憨子说的吗？

她看见叶开的眼神一片澄明，心中一惊，难道他好了？
“你好了吗，叶开？”
叶开心想，我现在还不能暴露已经康复，就让眼神变得迷茫起来，懵懂地问道：“什么好了？我病了吗？”
王艳摇摇头，“还是个憨子，我以为你好了呢。”
王艳把叶开送到门口，抱着他不肯撒手，恨不能把自己楔进叶开的身体里。
剧烈的敲门声把王艳从梦境里拉回现实，
她恋恋不舍地松开手，跑进厨房，拿了一块熟牛肉，用报纸包好了塞进叶开手里。
王艳叮嘱叶开：“回家把牛肉炖了补一补，养好了身体，今晚再过来！”
送走了叶开，王艳来到厢房门前，骂道：“老家伙，你敲什么敲！”
门刚一打开，张有权就揪住王艳的衣领，怒声喝道：“你个臭娘们，你干什么的，叫了半天都不开门？”
“你个老家伙，你昨天干了什么坏事，自己不知道啊？
你侮辱了我妹妹，还来问我，我打死你！”
王艳薅着张有权的头发，扭打起来。
“啊……疼死我了！”张有权嗷嗷直叫。
“打死你这个老龟孙！叫你欺负我妹妹！”
content_en:
At dawn, Wang Yan was awakened by a fierce knock on the door.
Only then did she remember that Zhang had the right to be locked in the wing.
Wang Yan struggled to get up, but her whole body was sore and weak, as if falling apart, and it hurt wherever she moved.
"Ouch!" Wang Yan lay down helplessly and turned her head to look at Ye Kai next to her.
Ye Kai is still sleeping soundly. Wang Yan can't put it down with her long eyelashes, high bridge of nose, and square lips. The more she looks at her, the more she likes her.
What a handsome guy!
His physical strength is so good that even a calf cannot compare to him.
After living for more than twenty years, I finally became a real woman. Even if I die, it will be worth it!
Thinking about last night, it was so enjoyable!
It would be great if she could marry him, Wang Yan sighed in her heart.
Looking at Ye Kai, Wang Yan suddenly became energetic again, and she decided to ignore Zhang Quanquan.
Let the old guy bark in the wing, it's useless to yell at him!
Thinking of this, Wang Yan hugged Ye Kai tightly.
"Dong dong dong!" The knock on the door sounded again.
Ye Kai woke up and said, "No, Zhang Quanquan is still in the wing!"
Wang Yan said calmly: "Don't worry about him, just let him shout. When he gets tired of shouting, he will be honest!"
"No, he keeps shouting and will call the neighbors over."
"That's right, I'll go get him out."
"Don't worry, let him out after I leave."
Wang Yan looked at Ye Kai in surprise. Does this sound like what a fool said?
When she saw Ye Kai's eyes were clear, she was shocked. Could it be that he was fine?
"Are you okay, Ye Kai?"
Ye Kaixin thought, I can't reveal that I have recovered yet, so his eyes became confused and he asked confusedly: "What's better? Am I sick?"
Wang Yan shook her head, "You're still a fool, I thought you were better."
Wang Yan sent Ye Kai to the door, hugging him and refusing to let go, wishing she could wedge herself into Ye Kai's body.
A fierce knock on the door brought Wang Yan back to reality from her dream.
She reluctantly let go of her hand, ran into the kitchen, took a piece of cooked beef, wrapped it in newspaper and stuffed it into Ye Kai's hand.
Wang Yan told Ye Kai: "Go home and stew beef to replenish your health. Come back tonight!"
After sending Ye Kai off, Wang Yan came to the door of the wing and cursed: "Old guy, what are you knocking on!"
As soon as the door opened, Zhang Quanquan grabbed Wang Yan's collar and shouted angrily: "You stinky bitch, what did you do, you didn't open the door after calling for a long time?"
"You old guy, you didn't know what bad things you did yesterday?
You insulted my sister and you come to ask me, I will beat you to death! "
Wang Yan pulled Zhang Quanquan's hair and started to struggle.
"Ah...it hurts me to death!" Zhang Quanquan screamed.
"I'll beat you to death, you old turtle! I told you to bully my sister!"
